description_en: Updates the employee type binding for a travel standard (all employees or specified employees)
description_zh: 更新差旅标准绑定员工类型(全员使用、指定员工使用)
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen travel-standard-scope-save --from-group false --rule-id 6516571 --scope 1 --x-acs-btrip-corp-token feth00jqwls --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TravelStandardScopeSave

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use the group travel standard. This parameter is optional. If not specified, the system determines whether to use the group travel standard based on unified travel management settings
parameters.help_zh: 是否走集团差标【选填】，如果不传则根据差旅统一管控来判断是否走集团差标
parameters.name: from_group

parameters.help_en: The ID of the travel standard rule
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The usage scope of the travel standard
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en: A header parameter obtained from the "Enterprise Access Credential" operation. Add it to the request header. In HTTP mode, you can use corp_token=value in the URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh: header 参数,由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在 header 里）,http 模式可以在链接中使用 corp_token=value 来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token
